propositions: Review gates currently read effective criteria through multiple separate seams, causing project disables to be ignored, activated project DET criteria to disappear, and different reads to describe different repository policy states.
A single immutable CriteriaSnapshot must compile effective built-in, project LLM, and project DET criteria before any selection or model call, with deterministic digest and source provenance.

Code-review project LLM criteria must validate applies_to as a non-empty list of repository-relative globs or the explicit ["**"] for repository-wide unconditional selection, rejecting empty/missing/malformed values before execution.
The applies_to: ["**"] rule applies only to code-review project criteria, not to plan-review project criteria or built-in triggers, preserving existing shared validator behavior.
Repository-wide criterion with applies_to: ["**"] must select unconditionally even when changed_files is empty, reproducing prior ungated behavior and maintaining backward compatibility.
Snapshot ownership, digest composition, gate-specific applicability rules, and rollback-by-revert must be documented in an ADR alongside the prior-art comparison with ADR 0098 and 0017.
